dz: 西汉王朝末年,王满宣称"天下神命"要求灭王朝并开始自取灭亡,即新朝.
de: The Western Han dynasty ends when Wang Mang claims that the divine Mandate of Heaven called for the end of the dynasty and the beginning of his own, the Xin dynasty.

dz: 特乌托堡森林之战结束:罗马帝国遭受了史上最惨重的失败,莱茵河被确立为帝国与所谓野蛮人之间的边界,持续了后四百年.
de: The Battle of the Teutoburg Forest ends: The Roman Empire suffers the greatest defeat of its history and the Rhine is established as the border between the Empire and the so-called barbarians for the next four hundred years.
